description: This is an API route handler file for managing recipes in a web application. It uses FastAPI to define endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and sharing recipes. The file interacts with database models for recipes and related entities and includes utility functions for filtering and pagination.

methods.name: _apply_search_filters(query, q: Optional[str], tags: Optional[List[str]])
methods.description: Applies search filters on the recipes query based on text and tags.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Recipe],int] _paginate(query, page: int, page_size: int)
methods.description: Paginates the query results, returning the items and total count.

methods.name: _replace_children(db: Session, recipe: Recipe, data: RecipeUpdate | RecipeCreate)
methods.description: Replaces ingredients, steps, media assets, and tags of a recipe based on provided data.

methods.name: list_recipes( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Free text search in title and description"), tags: Optional[List[str]] = Query(None, description="Filter by tags"), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Items per page"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Optional[User] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Lists recipes with optional search filters and pagination.

methods.name: get_recipe(recipe_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Optional[User] = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific recipe by ID.

methods.name: create_recipe(payload: RecipeCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new recipe in the database.

methods.name: update_recipe( recipe_id: int, payload: RecipeUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates an existing recipe, only if authorized.

methods.name: delete_recipe(recipe_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a recipe, only if authorized.

methods.name: toggle_share(recipe_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Placeholder endpoint for toggling sharing status of a recipe.
